title: A phase hold inside a network, then an edit on the held island: liquid ethane flows through a tank at 95 K; liquid nitrogen joins and the tank would split into two liquids, which the network does not carry (HELD (phases), retried, parked); the nitrogen generator is set to 1 atm and the held island accepts the edit at its fence (E4 row 10, acceptAtFence; added 2026-10-17)

steps.text: row 12: P3 joins the liquid nitrogen to the ethane tank; the tank would hold two hydrocarbon liquids, so the island holds (HELD (phases)), retries once and waits for a change to its network
row 12: an edit on the held island: the nitrogen generator to 1 atm (gas, below the tank, no backflow); the held island accepts it at its fence without a solve
